bullets: Week vs the Monday plan: the bull path played out in full — 7025 was reclaimed Sunday, and ES ran through 7086, 7120–25 and 7211–23 to tag 7305–09 at 7313.25 Monday. The bear path to 6897 never triggered; Wednesday's 6982.50 low held the 6960–66 pivot.

Wednesday data: GDP 4.3% vs 3.5% expected (prior 3.4%); core PCE 0.3% month-on-month (in line) and 3.3% year-on-year vs 3.2% expected; claims 189k vs 200k; durable goods 0.2% vs 0.7%. ES sold to 6982.50 at 6:45 AM PT, then ripped to 7211. Beige Book: employment rose slightly, prices increased moderately.

Intraday plan that was posted: the long was the 6992–93 Sunday overnight low as a failed breakdown, with 7025 as a lower-quality reclaim. Targets 7039 / 7052 / 7072, then 7087, 7105, 7150, 7223 and a 7305–09 retest. Price reached 7211 by 10:50 AM PT.
Auction read: Tuesday rejected Monday's value and filled Monday's excess low; the weekly profile is a double distribution. Buyers' next job is a 7240 reclaim.
Positioning: the last full options board is Friday 11/20's close and is not current. A Wednesday morning print noted SPY 700 as a put wall still overhead. No new dark-pool lines were posted.
2018 analog: the week started ahead of that path after Monday's rip; by Wednesday morning QQQ was sitting on it (path 616 vs about 618 pre-market).
Holiday: Thursday closed. Friday closes 10:00 AM PT, weekly expiration. Thanksgiving week has been higher in 8 of the last 9 years — this week is already sharply higher from Friday's close.
